limitations: A source shared before the tour end can contain later-tour footage; share time alone does not assign every segment to Halloween.
Current stream-start metadata and caption offsets are separate evidence. Their small countdown offset difference is not resolved and cannot certify an exact absolute race clock.

The explicit Time Trial caption around21:56 appears after the reset with Paris-map context; course identity, runner, total and full-race footage remain unverified. This review does not certify any Paris tour history.
Halloween mentions later in the transcript concern a costume and scoring; they do not establish a Halloween-tour result.
Automatic captions are not exhaustive audio or pixel evidence. Silent or mistranscribed segments are not excluded. No public records, dates or fastest-recording selections changed.
